facts.fact: 五年前 Nate Yellow Tail 在 Duck Lake 差点丧命；这是他时隔五年首次回到 Duck Lake。
facts.anchor: It was the first time Nate Yellow Tail had been back to Duck Lake since it almost killed him five years ago.

facts.fact: 当年中枪那晚，Cassidy Sees Elk 用一把一战步枪射中了 Nate，但中枪时他甚至没觉得疼。
facts.anchor: Funny thing was, when Cassidy Sees Elk shot Nate with that World War I rifle, it hadn’t even hurt.

facts.fact: 那晚（后来被新闻称作 Duck Lake Massacre）只有两名幸存者，Nate 是其中之一。
facts.anchor: This spooky Indian was one of only two to have made it through that night.

facts.fact: 另一名幸存者是 Denorah Cross Guns（D）：枪击案时两人都是十四岁；她曾守在 ICU 的 Nate 病床边，骂了他一句后哭着跑去叫 Nate 的妈妈。
facts.anchor: “Fuck you, Nate Yellow Tail,” D had whispered, the first cuss words he’d ever heard from her—they were fourteen—and then her tears were all coming at once and she was running to get Nate’s mom, and no one could run like Denorah Cross Guns could.

facts.fact: Sebby 因为父亲与议会的纠纷没上 Blackfeet 花名册，去年满十八岁时没领到那笔死亡赔偿金（claim check）。
facts.anchor: But what not being on the rolls meant was that he didn’t get his claim check last year when he turned eighteen.

facts.fact: Nate 和 Sebby（情同兄弟的搭档）用撬棍撬开了 Duck Lake 湖边的 A-frame 度假屋大门闯入行窃；Nate 把这当作对白人偷走整块大陆的「文化义务／报复」（winter warrior）。
facts.anchor: When nobody answered, Nate spun the crowbar up to Sebby like they did this all the time and Sebby wedged it in between the door and the frame and leaned forward, giving it his lanky weight.

facts.fact: 洗劫时两人砍坏皮沙发、折断刀具、把马桶踢裂，又把一幅背面用马克笔标价 6000 美元（$6000）的金属画揉成团扔掉。
facts.anchor: Only at the end did they see the price tag written on back with black marker: $6000.

facts.fact: 得手返程时 Sebby 驾车，一辆碎石车撞上驾驶侧车门、把车撞进树里；Nate 被甩向自己一侧的车窗，车窗正在碎裂、他的脸即将穿窗而出（章末悬念）。
facts.anchor: He was still laughing when the gravel truck barreling down the road slammed into the driver’s-side door, sent them spinning into the trees, the first one catching the passenger side front fender hard, so Nate, rag doll that he was, was flung into the window on his side.
